title: Checkout latency spike after payment retry config change
root_cause: Increased retry count caused synchronous blocking in order-service, which cascaded to API gateway timeouts
resolution: Reverted retry count and added circuit breaker to order-service

title: Auth token expiry change broke billing
root_cause: Services assumed 24h token validity; shorter expiry caused constant re-authentication storms
resolution: Updated all services to refresh tokens proactively

title: Database connection pool exhaustion
root_cause: Increased concurrent requests overwhelmed fixed connection pool
resolution: Increased pool size and reduced timeout back to 5000ms

title: Cache stampede after redis TTL change
root_cause: Shorter TTL caused simultaneous cache misses across all instances
resolution: Added jitter to TTL and restored longer baseline

title: Notification storm from Kafka consumer lag
root_cause: Consumer group rebalance caused duplicate event processing
resolution: Restored timeout and added idempotency keys

title: Fraud detection false positives spike
root_cause: Rule threshold change flagged legitimate transactions
resolution: Reverted threshold and added A/B testing for rule changes

title: Inventory overselling after sync change
root_cause: Reduced sync frequency caused stale inventory reads
resolution: Restored sync interval and added read-through cache

title: API gateway 502 errors during deploy
root_cause: Gateway health check timeout shorter than service cold start
resolution: Increased timeout and added graceful startup
